language_policy: Canadian English and standard Metropolitan French primary. Regional variants remain sense-qualified metadata; arrêt d’autobus is a Canadian French alternative to arrêt de bus. Independent per-language CEFR estimates remain unverified. Concept identities and meanings approved by the project owner on 2026-10-13 in meaning-approval.v0.2.0.json; linguistic review remains separate.
source_policy: Original editorial draft. Photographable means a meaning can be represented in a photo, literally or through a recognisable staged scene. No dictionary definitions or proprietary CEFR lists copied. All levels, translations, accessibility and interpretive examples await human review.

concepts.definition: Furniture intended for sleeping, rather than bedding alone.

photography.guidance: Show a made bed without people or private details.
photography.alternative: Photograph a miniature bed with its mattress and blanket visible.
photography.accessibility: Low effort indoors; no lifting or rearranging needed.
photography.safety: Use a safe setting and props you already have. Ask any participant for consent to the photo and any sharing; cropping may not hide identity. Avoid strangers, children, private details and hazards. Do not provoke real distress. A staged scene is an interpretation, not proof about a person.
